<script>
	Vue.component('settings-box', {
		template: '#vue-component-settings-box',
		props: ['selected', 'title', 'options', 'type', 'format'],
		data: function() {
			return {
				box: {
					hasFormat: (this.format && typeof this.format === 'object' && this.format.name && this.format.value),
					title: this.title,
					options: this.options,
					type: this.type,
					selected: this.selected,
				},
			};
		},
		methods: {
			getFormat: function(what, object) {
				if(!this.box.hasFormat) return object;
				return what === 'name' ? object[this.format.name] : object[this.format.value];
			},
			save: function() {
				this.$emit('change', this.box.selected);
			},
			close: function() {
				this.$emit('close', this.box.selected);
			}
		}
	});
</script>

<script>
	Vue.component('settings-box', {
		template: '#vue-component-settings-box',
		props: ['selected', 'title', 'options', 'type', 'format'],
		data: function() {
			return {
				box: {
					hasFormat: (this.format && typeof this.format === 'object' && this.format.name && this.format.value),
					title: this.title,
					options: this.options,
					type: this.type,
					selected: this.selected,
				},
			};
		},
		methods: {
			getFormat: function(what, object) {
				if(!this.box.hasFormat) return object;
				return what === 'name' ? object[this.format.name] : object[this.format.value];
			},
			save: function() {
				this.$emit('change', this.box.selected);
			},
			close: function() {
				this.$emit('close', this.box.selected);
			}
		}
	});
</script>

<script>
	Vue.component('settings-box', {
		template: '#vue-component-settings-box',
		props: ['selected', 'title', 'options', 'type', 'format'],
		data: function() {
			return {
				box: {
					hasFormat: (this.format && typeof this.format === 'object' && this.format.name && this.format.value),
					title: this.title,
					options: this.options,
					type: this.type,
					selected: this.selected,
				},
			};
		},
		methods: {
			getFormat: function(what, object) {
				if(!this.box.hasFormat) return object;
				return what === 'name' ? object[this.format.name] : object[this.format.value];
			},
			save: function() {
				this.$emit('change', this.box.selected);
			},
			close: function() {
				this.$emit('close', this.box.selected);
			}
		}
	});
</script>

<script>
	Vue.component('settings-box', {
		template: '#vue-component-settings-box',
		props: ['selected', 'title', 'options', 'type', 'format'],
		data: function() {
			return {
				box: {
					hasFormat: (this.format && typeof this.format === 'object' && this.format.name && this.format.value),
					title: this.title,
					options: this.options,
					type: this.type,
					selected: this.selected,
				},
			};
		},
		methods: {
			getFormat: function(what, object) {
				if(!this.box.hasFormat) return object;
				return what === 'name' ? object[this.format.name] : object[this.format.value];
			},
			save: function() {
				this.$emit('change', this.box.selected);
			},
			close: function() {
				this.$emit('close', this.box.selected);
			}
		}
	});
</script>

<script>
	Vue.component('settings-box', {
		template: '#vue-component-settings-box',
		props: ['selected', 'title', 'options', 'type', 'format'],
		data: function() {
			return {
				box: {
					hasFormat: (this.format && typeof this.format === 'object' && this.format.name && this.format.value),
					title: this.title,
					options: this.options,
					type: this.type,
					selected: this.selected,
				},
			};
		},
		methods: {
			getFormat: function(what, object) {
				if(!this.box.hasFormat) return object;
				return what === 'name' ? object[this.format.name] : object[this.format.value];
			},
			save: function() {
				this.$emit('change', this.box.selected);
			},
			close: function() {
				this.$emit('close', this.box.selected);
			}
		}
	});
</script>

<script>
	Vue.component('settings-box', {
		template: '#vue-component-settings-box',
		props: ['selected', 'title', 'options', 'type', 'format'],
		data: function() {
			return {
				box: {
					hasFormat: (this.format && typeof this.format === 'object' && this.format.name && this.format.value),
					title: this.title,
					options: this.options,
					type: this.type,
					selected: this.selected,
				},
			};
		},
		methods: {
			getFormat: function(what, object) {
				if(!this.box.hasFormat) return object;
				return what === 'name' ? object[this.format.name] : object[this.format.value];
			},
			save: function() {
				this.$emit('change', this.box.selected);
			},
			close: function() {
				this.$emit('close', this.box.selected);
			}
		}
	});
</script>
